items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: I think I had gone to see him with Don Redman.

ctx.x: This is really where you got to hear Louis, was it?

Stanley and Baby, I told Baby about this many times. So I told Pops about it, we talked one day and I think I had gone to see him with Don Redman. We were going to hear Louis at the Paramount. So we get to talking and they got to talking about something so I didn't bother ... so one day I had a little gig. I was at the Paramount in the basement of the Paramount, you know at the Chiles. And we had some things going there so I told him about this. So he played a tune. So, Joe Giggles was said, Let me in. He could…
Bit about your impressions on this occasion when you heard Louis.
